facts.text: Through the Community Commitment Program, new undergraduate students receive at least 50% tuition coverage if they, a parent, legal guardian, or spouse are employed full-time in qualifying service fields including healthcare, education, ministry, military, or government.

sources.title: Community Commitment | McMurry University
sources.quote: The Community Commitment Program guarantees eligible students at least 50% tuition coverage through McMurry University institutional scholarships and grants.
